verdicts.why: The seed renders ಮಲಗೋ ಕೋಣೆಯ as the compound "bedroom"; "sleeping" is a literal gloss of one half of it, and the row is still about this sentence.
The seed has "those places", so "that" is the singular form of a word that is in the sentence.
The seed has "to wake up every morning and see the mountains", so "seeing" is an inflected form of "see".
The seed "What you said madam" has no rendering of ಅದು; the row glosses a word the translation dropped, and its own LEGO covers it.
The seed says "explain what I mean", and "my meaning" is a literal gloss of ನನ್ನ ಅರ್ಥ that the seed does not render that way.
The seed renders ಇಲ್ಲ only as the n't in "wouldn't like", so "not" is a literal gloss of a negation that is fused into the contraction.
The seed has "all day" where the row says "whole", so it glosses a word the seed renders differently.
The seed has "want you to speak", and "should speak" is a literal gloss of ಮಾತಾಡಬೇಕು that the sentence does not render.
The seed "find out what the answer is" has no "that"; this is a particle gloss.
The seed has "to answer" where the row says "to give", so it is a literal gloss of ಕೊಡೋಕೆ.

The seed has "start talking", so "to do" is a literal gloss of ಮಾಡೋದು that the sentence does not render.
The seed has "tonight", so "today" is a literal gloss of ಇವತ್ತು.
The seed has "doesn't want", so "don't want" is the wrong person of a phrase that is in the sentence. Fixing it would be a judgement call.

The seed has "this morning", so "today" is a literal gloss of ಇವತ್ತು.
